title: PacketPulse Brand Pattern Starter Assets
note: Transparent overlays. SVGs use CSS custom properties and are intended for inline embedding/React components so tokens can flow into the artwork. They do not contain a background rectangle except the repeating dot fill in the matrix asset, which is itself transparent outside the dots.

creative_direction.background_policy: Transparent overlays only for the current pattern exercise; do not replace or repaint existing page/card backgrounds.
creative_direction.design_guidance: Creative and experimental. Families, colours, gradients, line weights, crops, densities and motion variants may be evolved or replaced.
creative_direction.pantone_note: Pantone references may guide physical/print studies. Never invent PMS identifiers or claim a direct Pantone match from HEX alone; record the official reference and digital conversion if used.
